decisions.reason: Although peripheral to the machinery core, the accelerator still supports the firm's advisory role and external learning links, but in a growing R&D-intensive firm it is the easiest offer to cut if management tightens focus on core recycling equipment.

As a flagship sustainability product with some overlap to the firm's recycling knowledge and R&D base, it is likely to be retained while management continues to learn about technical refinement and market fit, though its material-chemistry orientation makes it less secure than the core plants.

The infectious-waste decontamination plant is close to the firm's modular treatment and engineering capabilities, so high related knowledge and strong absorptive capacity favor continued commercialization.

The mobile mechanical recycling plant sits squarely in the firm's core machinery, recycling and service know-how, making it the product management is most likely to keep backing and improve incrementally.
